model: claude -p (default model: claude-opus-5-5), model and critic

tasks.name: weather
widgetFaults: designed-scroll: The hourly strip scrolls sideways and clips a column mid-glyph at both widths (18:00 at 380 px, 23:00 at 1024 px) with no fade or scroll cue, so the 22:00–00:00 rain the note promises is hidden off-screen on a phone; the widget should show a scroll affordance or fade at the edge.
words-not-bent: The widget's generated footer reads "Rain likely on Today.", which is ungrammatical; it should say "Rain likely today." when the day label is "Today".

tasks.name: habits
widgetFaults: data-agrees: The status line says '3 of 3 habits on track this week' while every habit shows 0/7 with Monday already missed against a 7-per-week target, so it should report 0 of 3 on track, or none started yet.

reads-at-phone: At 380 px the edit and delete icons crowd the name column, so 'Read 20 minutes' wraps onto two lines while the other rows stay on one; giving the name more width keeps the rows consistent.

tasks.name: recipe
widgetFaults: every-element-bound: The header icon is a generic target glyph that carries no data, so it reads as placeholder filler beside the title.

tasks.name: bill
widgetFaults: money-has-currency: The 'Bill before tip' input shows a bare 186 and each 'Drinks' input shows a bare 0, with no € sign or prefix, even though every other amount on the card carries the euro.
choice-once: The custom tip field repeats the selected 10% chip's value, so the same choice shows twice; leave the custom field empty unless a non-preset tip is entered.

tasks.name: running
widgetFaults: tile-rows-wrap: At 380 px the Run type and Week filter chip rows run past the card edge ('Long', 'Intervals' and 'Week of Oct 13' are cut off) instead of wrapping.
no-truncation: At 380 px the day chart's x-axis labels are truncated to 'Oc…', so the bars can't be dated.
